line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.

verification.scope: Fresh baseline hash, filtered source difference and logical line check; prior compiler controls cited in decision. No production change or new runtime test.

decision: R2321: four declarations across three sites need PSERVERINFO, RESCALLS/PRESCALLS, and CFNSCSENDMESSAGE. The earlier product compile rejects the missing private types; the admitted WOW gpsi is a DWORD guest address and cannot satisfy the original USER pointer contract. R2323: the fifth declaration defines an extern array with ICLS_MAX as a required constant bound; actual C2065/C2057 prove unavailable server class registry. No synthetic type, bound or alternate owner. DEBUG/WX86 arms remain excluded.
